import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;
    
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] next = new int[M];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int e;
    
    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        to[e] = v; cap[e] = w; next[e] = head[u]; head[u] = e++;
        to[e] = u; cap[e] = 0; next[e] = head[v]; head[v] = e++;
    }
    
    static int S, T;
    static int[] dist = new int[N];
    static int[] q = new int[N*2];
    static int[] arc = new int[N];
    static int[] gap = new int[N];
    static int[] inq = new int[N];
    static int[] pre = new int[N];
    
    static int SAP(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(arc, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        int qf=0, qr=0;
        q[qr++] = t; inq[t]=1; gap[0]++; dist[t]=0;
        while(qf < qr) {
            int u = q[qf++];
            for(int i=head[u]; i!=-1; i=next[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                if(inq[v]==0) {
                    q[qr++] = v;
                    inq[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u]+1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    arc[v] = head[v];
                }
            }
        }
        int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
        pre[s] = s;
        while(dist[s] < t) {
            boolean flag = false;
            for(int i=arc[u]; i!=-1; i=next[i]) {
                if(cap[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]]+1 == dist[u]) {
                    flag = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, cap[i]);
                    pre[to[i]] = u;
                    u = to[i];
                    if(u == t) {
                        while(u != s) {
                            u = pre[u];
                            cap[arc[u]] -= low;
                            cap[arc[u]^1] += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
            if(flag) continue;
            int mindis = t+1;
            for(int i=head[u]; i!=-1; i=next[i]) {
                if(cap[i] > 0 && mindis > dist[to[i]]) {
                    mindis = dist[to[i]];
                    arc[u] = i;
                }
            }
            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if(gap[dist[u]]==0) return ans;
            dist[u] = mindis+1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = pre[u];
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    static char[][] str = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] str2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] ca = new int[12][12];
    static int[][][] stone = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, t;
    
    static void expand() {
        for(int k=1; k<=t; ++k) {
            for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
                for(int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                    if(stone[k-1][i][j] == 1)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    else if(stone[k-1][i][j] == 2)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    else {
                        for(int z=0; z<4; ++z) {
                            int nx = i + dir[z][0];
                            int ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if(nx>=1 && nx<=n && ny>=1 && ny<=n) {
                                if(stone[k-1][nx][ny] == 2)
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean[][] vis = new boolean[12][12];
    static void dfs(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        vis[nowx][nowy] = true;
        dp[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if(k >= t || stone[k][nowx][nowy] != 0)
            return;
        for(int z=0; z<4; ++z) {
            int nx = nowx + dir[z][0];
            int ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if(nx>=1 && nx<=n && ny>=1 && ny<=n && !vis[nx][ny]) {
                if(stone[k][nx][ny] != 0)
                    continue;
                dfs(x, y, nx, ny, k+1);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for(int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                str[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if(str[i][j] == 'Z')
                    stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if(str[i][j] == 'Y')
                    stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                else
                    sci[i][j] = str[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        
        for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for(int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                str2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if(str2[i][j] >= '0' && str2[i][j] <= '9')
                    ca[i][j] = str2[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        
        expand();
        
        for(int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for(int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                if(sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for(int a=1; a<=n; ++a) Arrays.fill(vis[a], false);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for(int k=1; k<=t; ++k) {
            for(int x=1; x<=n; ++x) {
                for(int y=1; y<=n; ++y) {
                    for(int nx=1; nx<=n; ++nx) {
                        for(int ny=1; ny<=n; ++ny) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        S = 0;
        T = n*n;
        // No output as original code does not print
    }
}
